content:
While 2025 in the technology world passed through trial processes, 2026 stands out as a period in which these experiences turn into operational outcomes. Businesses now assess AI technologies not only as a tool, but as a strategic necessity at the center of business processes.

Technological Transformation and Agent Systems

AI systems are evolving from screen-based applications into structures that can make decisions in the physical world. The main concepts that stand out in this process are:

  • Agentic AI: Autonomous systems that carry out work toward specific goals without human intervention.
  • Multiagent Systems: Architectures in which AI agents with different specialties collaborate, make autonomous decisions, and create direct P&L impact.
  • Physical AI: Robotics and autonomous vehicles taking an active role on production lines and in warehouses to perform work in the physical world.

Infrastructure and Security Architecture

With the increase in data use and token costs, businesses are shifting from fully cloud-focused strategies to hybrid models (cloud, edge computing, and on-premise deployment). Confidential Computing technologies ensure that data remains encrypted while being processed, while digital asset verification processes are gaining importance.

On the cybersecurity side, the use of AI-based preventive defense mechanisms (Preemptive Cybersecurity) against AI-supported attacks has also become a necessity. Legacy perimeter defense models are inadequate against threats developing at machine speed.

Organizational Structuring

Traditional organizational structures are changing under the impact of automation and no-code platforms. Large organizations are being replaced by agile micro-teams of 2-4 people, strengthened by AI-supported tools, and by solopreneur-focused structures. In this new period, success comes not from patching technology onto existing processes, but from rebuilding the entire architecture with the principles of “secure-by-design and digital-by-default”.
